name: Serpentine Eagle Figurine of Wondrous Power
body:
Price 9,100 gp

DESCRIPTION

This variant of the serpentine owl can be transformed into an eagle or giant eagle but is otherwise identical to the owl figurine. Serpentine eagles are popular for scouting and emergency transportation.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Cost 4,550 gp
